Technical brand sheet

Typography

// 3 families
ANTON — display weight 400 only · UPPERCASE · Google Fonts
Skaters ride free
Used for: H1–H3, stat numerals, callout headlines, CTA panel titles. Line-height 0.96–1.15, letter-spacing 0.005–0.01em. Never in body copy, never mixed-case.
HANKEN GROTESK — body weights 400 / 600 / 700 · Google Fonts
Regular 400 carries all body copy at 15–18px, line-height 1.55. Semibold 600 handles inline emphasis and CTA-panel copy. Bold 700 is rare — reserve it for maximum-urgency lines.
Used for: paragraphs, table cells, list items, product descriptions. Max line length ~66ch.
SPACE MONO — metadata weights 400 / 700 · Google Fonts
// SECTION EYEBROWS · TAPE LABELS · STAT CAPTIONS
[FILL-IN SLOTS] · TABLE HEADERS · VER 0.1 FOOTERS
Used for: everything machine-ish — labels, eyebrows, tape, slots, footers, code. 11–15px, letter-spacing 0.04–0.08em, uppercase. Bold 700 for tape and slots, 400 elsewhere.

Structure

// layout + borders
TokenValueNotes
radius0 — everywhereEnforced globally: border-radius:0 !important. Brutalist rule, no exceptions.
border-heavy2px solid #F2F2F0Cards, tables, swatches. 3px under section heads.
border-light1px solid #2C2C2CInternal dividers only.
border-accent6px solid #D8F927 (left)Callout panels.
page-widthmax 880px · pad 24pxSingle-column document flow.
section-gap80–88px vertical48px in print media query.
card-pad~24px / internal 14–22pxCard gutters 18–22px.
breakpoint640pxGrids collapse to single column; right borders become bottom borders.

Component recipes

// signature elements
SPONSOREDWARNINGNEW SPOT

Duct tape label

  • font: Space Mono 700 / 13px / 0.08em UPPERCASE
  • pad 5px 14px · text always #0A0A0A
  • rotate: -1.5° chartreuse · +1.2° orange · -0.8° cyan
  • no drop shadow — RN can't contain a rotated view's shadow inside its layout box, so it clips on iOS/web

EXP / meter bar

  • track: 22px tall · #1E1E1E · 2px INK border
  • fill: repeating hazard stripe -45°
  • stripe A #D8F927 0–12px · stripe B #B8D81F 12–24px
  • caption row: Space Mono 12px, INK-DIM, above bar
[X,XXX]

Fill-in slot

  • font: Space Mono 700 · color #35E8FF
  • always wrapped in [square brackets]
  • marks any value pending real data — replace before sending
Local density beats global reach

Accent callout

  • bg #151515 · left border 6px #D8F927
  • headline: Anton UPPERCASE · body: Hanken INK-DIM
  • one per section maximum

Controls

// switch / toggle / dropdown
GHOST MODE
BATTLE ALERTS

Switch

  • track: 52 × 28px · 2px INK border · rectangular, never a pill
  • thumb: 18px square · 3px inset · slides 24px
  • off: track #1E1E1E / thumb #9C9C96
  • on: track #D8F927 / thumb #0A0A0A
  • motion: 120ms mechanical slide, no bounce
  • label: Space Mono 12px, INK-DIM off → INK on

Toggle group

  • segments share one 2px INK frame + 2px internal dividers
  • font: Space Mono 700 / 12px / 0.06em UPPERCASE
  • pad 9px 16px · inactive: SURFACE bg / INK-DIM text
  • active: #D8F927 bg / #0A0A0A text — hard cut, no slide
  • exactly one segment active · 2–4 segments max
SORT SPOTS BY

Dropdown

  • trigger: input recipe — #1E1E1E bg · 2px INK border · Hanken 15px
  • label above: Space Mono 11px INK-DIM UPPERCASE
  • caret: solid #D8F927 triangle · rotates 180° · 120ms
  • open: trigger border → chartreuse · menu 4px below
  • menu: SURFACE bg · 2px INK border · shadow 3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.55)
  • option: Hanken 15px · hover #1E1E1E · selected: 4px chartreuse left border

Shared control rules: radius 0, focus state is a 2px chartreuse border/outline, all targets ≥ 44px including padding, state changes are labelled — never color alone.

Usage rules

// keep it consistent

ALWAYS

  • Zero border-radius on every element
  • #0A0A0A text on any neon background
  • Hard-offset shadows only, and only on dropdown/menu surfaces
  • One neon dominates per composition — chartreuse leads

NEVER

  • No rounded corners, pills, or soft shadows
  • No gradients except the hazard stripe
  • No neon-on-neon text pairings
  • No pure #FFFFFF or pure #000000
